title: Caustic Bulb

sources.title: Caustic Brine
markers: | summary = a type of [[surface]] created by throwing or breaking a [[Caustic Bulb]]. It also appears after destroying some environmental clutter found on [[Nautiloid]] such as [[Brine Bulb]] and [[Brain Jar]].

summary: Throw as an Action up to 60 ft. Creates Caustic Brine, which deals 1d4 Acid to creatures on it without a save.

fields.Surface: Deals 1d4 Acid per turn on the surface. The item revision gives inconsistent radius values, 3 m and 19 ft.
fields.Base value: 2 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
